svg.title: simulate — exact generation, individual simulation checks and causal certification
svg.desc: Separate start resolution, retained-state handling, intervention generation, per-construct and per-indicator checks, causal certification and publication. Failed or unevaluated scientific checks remain findings; numeric effects require identified targets and matching production-fit evidence.
